name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
one_liner: Turns one AI coding assistant into a simulated 49-person game studio — directors, designers, artists, and QA testers that each do their specialized job and hand work to each other, so a solo developer gets the structure of a real team.
buyer: A solo indie game developer who keeps abandoning projects from lack of structure and can't afford to hire an actual art, design, and QA team.
business_use_cases: A solo developer uses it to simulate having a full studio pipeline, finishing a game they'd otherwise give up on alone.
A 2-3 person micro-studio adopts its coordination system instead of inventing their own process for dividing human and AI work.
A game-dev educator builds a course around it, teaching students how a real studio pipeline works through hands-on simulation.

money_ideas.idea: Paid genre-specific 'studio-in-a-box' templates (platformer, roguelike, visual novel) pre-tuned for this system.
A paid coaching community helping indie developers actually ship games using the workflow.

steal_this: Package one of the QA or playtesting agents standalone with a short tutorial and sell it this weekend to the large solo-gamedev audience, instead of the whole 49-agent system.
